note: The words players read in the Made for Groddle section of /restoration/ (tools/made-art/build-data.mjs): one piece per entry of tools/provenance/made-sprites.json, and the curated pieces from repainted-maps.json (map:<hub>, maps:<hub>,<hub>), subway-map-paper.json (subway:paper), world-map-2x.json (world:2x) and made-decos.json (decos:<group>[:<view>]). image.file and original.file under public/assets/made-art/ are pictures composed by tools/made-art/compose.py (tools/made-art/showcase.json). In facts and labels, {tool} is the provenance's model or tool, {overlap} the outline overlap its cut records, {w} and {h} the original's size in pixels, {regions} how many region maps were painted again. A gallery (maps:<hub>,<hub>) has parts: the words for each region's thumbnail and painting in the page's compare popup, where {name} is the region and {w} and {h} its thumbnail's size.

pieces.name: Quest book
pieces.caption: The open book on the card you see when you finish a quest. Tiny Speck drew it only {w} by {h} pixels, which turned soft and blurry when the card showed it large, so it was redrawn bigger to match the original as closely as possible.

image.label: Redrawn for Groddle
image.alt: The redrawn quest book: an open book with cream pages, a red cover and an orange bookmark, sharp at this size.

original.label: Tiny Speck's original, {w} by {h} pixels, shown at the same size
original.alt: Tiny Speck's quest book, enlarged so its pixels show: the same open book, blocky and soft.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Redrawn by an image model ({tool}) under Austin's direction, with Tiny Speck's own {w} by {h} book enlarged twelve times as the guide.

facts.label: How it was checked
facts.text: Shrunk back down to {w} by {h} pixels, its outline overlaps the original's by {overlap}.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: The card for a finished quest in the Modern look. The Classic look keeps Tiny Speck's original book.

pieces.name: Groddle Meadow map
pieces.caption: The painted background of the Groddle Meadow region map. Tiny Speck's full-size map paintings are lost as files, but the 2012 Encyclopedia drew this one at full size under the game's roads and street names. That picture was restored: the markings taken off and the painting sharpened, with everything else left where Tiny Speck put it.

image.label: Restored from 2012
image.alt: A painted top-down view of Groddle Meadow: rolling green fields, small trees and bushes, a flower patch and rocks, a cliff along the top edge and a forest at the right.

original.label: Tiny Speck's thumbnail, {w} by {h} pixels, shown at the same size
original.alt: Tiny Speck's small thumbnail of the same map, enlarged so its pixels show: the same fields and trees, blurred.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Restored by an image model ({tool}) under Austin's direction, from the 2012 Encyclopedia's picture of this map: asked to remove only the roads, names, icons and GO buttons and sharpen, without moving anything. Its colour was then brought back to the 2012 picture's.

facts.label: How it was chosen
facts.text: Austin compared it with the 2012 picture and with the painting made earlier from the thumbnail, and chose the restore. The other regions are being restored the same way, a batch at a time; until theirs comes back, each keeps the painting made from its thumbnail.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: The background of the Groddle Meadow map. The game draws its own streets, names and markers on top.

pieces.name: EZ Cookin' counters, lamps and table
pieces.caption: The glass serving counters, the white lamps over them and the round mosaic table of Breezy, EZ Cookin', the forest street where the EZ Cooking quest begins. No picture of them survives in Tiny Speck's files, only in players' snapshots of the street from 2012, so they were made again from their measured sizes.

image.label: Made for Groddle
image.alt: The made pieces at the same sizes: a mosaic-topped table on scrolled grey iron legs, a pale aqua glass lid over a white steel counter, and a white drum lamp hanging on four wires.

original.label: Our drawing of their sizes, measured from the 2012 snapshots
original.alt: Plain outlines of a round table, a glass-topped counter and a drum lamp hanging over it, at their measured sizes.

facts.label: What the 2012 street had
facts.text: Three glass-topped serving counters in a row along a pine forest lane at sunset, the food laid out on the glass, a white drum lamp hanging over each, and a small round table with a tiled top where the Knife & Board waited.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Drawn by an image model ({tool}) for Austin, one piece at a time. It was given our drawing of the sizes and four sheets of Tiny Speck's own glass, tables, lamps and forest art to match the look, and a description of each piece in words. Austin chose the pictures.

facts.label: How it was checked
facts.text: Each picture was measured against the drawing: the counter is within 3% of its shape, the lamp within 6% and the table within 8%. The food was set on the counters and the Knife & Board on the table where the street's own script puts them, and the street was walked in the game on a desktop and a phone, in both looks.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: Breezy, EZ Cookin', when you take its quest or pick EZ Cooking in the tutorial.

pieces.name: Breezy, EZ Cookin'
pieces.caption: The same stretch of the street before and after. Until the new pieces came, Tiny Speck pieces that were close enough stood in: a shop counter for each serving counter, a hanging shop lamp over each, and a wooden pedestal table. The shop lamps looked too much like swings, so for a while the street had no lamps at all.

image.label: With the pieces made for Groddle
image.alt: The forest lane with two glass-topped white counters, bread, cheese and meat on them, and a white drum lamp over each.

original.label: With Tiny Speck's stand-ins
original.alt: The same forest lane with beige shop counters on red legs, the same food on them, and green shop lamps hanging over them.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: The counters, lamps and table are by an image model ({tool}). Everything else on the street is Tiny Speck's own art, laid out where the 2012 snapshots show it.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: Both pictures are the game itself: the tutorial's EZ Cooking practice street, the food where the street's script lays it.

pieces.name: Subway map paper
pieces.caption: The paper under the Subway System map: pale sage green with cream sheets laid on it. Tiny Speck's full-size paper is lost. It survives only as the little map on the in-world Subway Map sign, so it was made again.

image.label: Made again for Groddle, the game's line drawn on it
image.alt: The recreated paper: cream sheets on soft sage green paper with faint fold creases, the red line and its stations drawn over it.

original.label: The map on Tiny Speck's Subway Map sign, {w} by {h} pixels, shown at the same height
original.alt: The little map on Tiny Speck's Subway Map sign, enlarged so its pixels show: cream sheets on pale green, a purple line with round stops.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Painted by an image model ({tool}) for Austin from our drawing of where the twelve sheets lie, measured from a 2012 picture of the map window, with the sign, Tiny Speck's world map charts and the station signs to match its look. It was asked for paper only: no line, no names.

facts.label: How it was checked
facts.text: Each sheet's edges were found and compared with the drawing, then the picture was gently stretched to line them up. After that, nearly every edge sits within one unit of where it belongs.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: The Subway view of the Map. The game draws the line, the stations and their names on top.

pieces.name: World map
pieces.caption: Tiny Speck's World map, sharpened for Retina screens. Tiny Speck drew its two charts, the painted one and the sketched one, only {w} by {h} pixels, and the World view shows them much larger on a sharp screen, where they looked soft. These are the same charts at twice the size: every coast, route and hand-lettered name where it was.

image.label: Sharpened for Groddle, twice the size
image.alt: The painted World map, crisp: dark blue sea, Groddle Isle and its neighbours in soft painted colours, the islands' names in Tiny Speck's own hand.

original.label: Tiny Speck's painted chart, {w} by {h} pixels, shown at the same size
original.alt: Tiny Speck's painted World map: the same sea, islands and names, softer and a little blocky.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Sharpened by an image model ({tool}) for Austin, one chart at a time, each asked to move and redraw nothing, only to take away the blur. A first try that redrew islands and lettering was thrown away.

facts.label: How it was checked
facts.text: Laid over Tiny Speck's charts and nudged onto their lines, then matched to their colours. Every part of each map sits within one pixel of where it is on the original, at the original's size. A few marks read more clearly than before: the dashed routes, a faint line beside Groddle Isle on the sketched chart, a small tick on the compass.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: The World view of the Map on a Retina screen or a phone, and on any screen once the map is shown larger than {w} by {h}. The region frames, cards and your star sit where they always did.

pieces.name: More region maps
pieces.caption: Three more of the region paintings made again from their thumbnails: Ix, Uralia and Haoma, from top to bottom. Each kept its region's own shape and colours.

image.label: Painted again for Groddle
image.alt: Three painted top-down maps: a golden and rose-brown island of two lobes, a small teal island scattered with stones on pale paper, and a forest of pale icy spires.

original.label: Tiny Speck's thumbnails, 150 by 91 pixels each, shown at the same size
original.alt: Tiny Speck's three small thumbnails of the same maps, enlarged so their pixels show.

original.label: {name}: Tiny Speck's thumbnail, {w} by {h} pixels
original.alt: Tiny Speck's small thumbnail of the {name} map, enlarged so its pixels show.

image.label: {name}: painted again for Groddle
image.alt: The {name} region map, painted again for Groddle from that thumbnail.

facts.label: How it was made
facts.text: Painted by an image model ({tool}) under Austin's direction, each given its region's own thumbnail and a drawing of where the game puts the region's streets, so they still land in the right places, then toned down a little.

facts.label: How it was checked
facts.text: Austin looked at each beside its thumbnail and kept it. {regions} regions in all were painted again, four of them with no thumbnail to follow, from their streets alone.

facts.label: In the game
facts.text: The backgrounds of the Ix, Uralia and Haoma region maps.
